findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional — `loop_advice` treats any committed Markdown change under `plans/` or `docs/`, or to `README.md`, as an answer. For a documentation task, a worker can revise a page to address a review finding without the owner settling the missing rule. `forge next` then drops the required owner question and offers the work step. The added test checks that a code-only edit leaves the question open, but does not cover this normal documentation path.
findings.title: An ordinary documentation edit can bypass the owner's second-round question

stop.proposed: cut the code that invites these findings; or replace the cases with one general rule; or narrow that Done when item; or make it fail closed
stop.reason: Owner: one focused round. The automatic default choice must update the plan's builder details the same way an explicit --resolve choice does; add a test for the default-choice path. Nothing else changes.

why: About 40% of review rounds are process waste: narrowing needs hand merges of the plan, rounds run with no change, and Forge's own records cost rounds and API calls
